column1: # Game profile of FM24 Touch (Switch, base game + update 1.0.1 = v65536). Plays on Android (android.tsv)
# Sports Interactive's own engine on SDK 16, OpenGL ES 3.1 through NVIDIA's GL driver (subsdk0 NintendoSDK_OpenGL, not loaded: the Android host hands the GL calls to the
# device's OpenGL ES driver, dm/android/gl_android.c); its 1,224 shaders are GLSL ES text in the RomFS (data/sigraphics/shaders/gles), compiled at run time, so the shader
# tables are empty. Started from the experimental port's survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py); its memory values held on the device.
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB − 48 MB of bss (counted as used memory): a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (Age of Calamity: 66.6 MB → 72 MB)
